hooks.prompt: Context compaction is about to occur. Before the conversation history is compacted, review the session and call capture_thought for any durable facts not yet saved to openbrain: decisions and their reasons, non-obvious fixes, stable project constraints, user preferences, milestones, or named follow-ups. Prefer one concise, self-contained capture per item with tags/projects/people metadata when clear. Do not capture raw transcripts, routine progress, or unvalidated guesses. Do not address the user.

openbrain session capture: the session is ending. Silently review all completed work and call capture_thought for durable facts likely to matter in future sessions: decisions and reasons, non-obvious fixes, stable project constraints, user preferences, milestones, or named follow-ups. Do not capture raw transcripts, command output, routine progress, obvious duplicates, or unvalidated guesses. Prefer one concise, self-contained capture per durable item, with tags/projects/people metadata when clear. Do not address the user unless capture fails in a way they need to know about.
